events.title: The Seinfeld Chronicles
events.description: The pilot episode airs. Kramer is called 'Kessler' and Elaine does not yet appear.

events.title: The Stake Out
events.description: The first official episode of the series introduces Julia Louis-Dreyfus as Elaine Benes.

events.title: Male Unbonding
events.description: The only episode in the series with a title that doesn't start with 'The'.

events.title: The Stock Tip
events.description: Season 1 finale. George and Jerry lose money on a stock while Kramer makes a killing.

events.title: The Ex-Girlfriend
events.description: Season 2 premieres. The show moves to a permanent time slot and starts building its audience.

events.title: The Jacket
events.description: Jerry buys an expensive suede jacket. We meet Elaine's terrifying father, Alton Benes.

events.title: The Revenge
events.description: George quits his job in a huff and tries to show up the next day as if it never happened.

events.title: The Chinese Restaurant
events.description: A landmark 'bottle episode' where the group spends the entire half-hour waiting for a table.

events.title: The Note
events.description: Season 3 premieres. Jerry, George, and Elaine get fake doctor's notes for massages.

events.title: The Pen
events.description: Jerry and Elaine visit his parents in Florida. Jerry 'takes' an astronaut pen from Jack Klompus.

events.title: The Library
events.description: Introduces Library Cop Lt. Joe Bookman, who investigates Jerry for a book overdue since 1971.

events.title: The Parking Garage
events.description: The group gets lost in a mall parking garage for the entire episode.

events.title: The Cafe
events.description: Jerry tries to help Babu Bhatt by suggesting he change his restaurant's menu to 'all-Pakistani'.

events.title: The Alternate Side
events.description: Kramer gets a line in a Woody Allen movie: 'These pretzels are making me thirsty!'

events.title: The Red Dot
events.description: George buys Elaine a discounted cashmere sweater with a red dot; he has sex with a cleaning lady.

events.title: The Pez Dispenser
events.description: Jerry makes Elaine laugh during a piano recital with a Tweety Bird Pez dispenser.

events.title: The Boyfriend
events.description: Jerry befriends Keith Hernandez. The episode parodies 'JFK' with the 'Magic Loogie' theory.

events.title: The Limo
events.description: Jerry and George steal a limo intended for a neo-Nazi leader named O'Brien.

events.title: The Keys
events.description: Season 3 finale. Kramer flees to California to become an actor after Jerry takes back his keys.

events.title: The Trip
events.description: Season 4 premieres in LA. Kramer is a suspect in the 'Smog Strangler' murders.

events.title: The Pitch
events.description: Jerry and George pitch a 'show about nothing' to NBC executives.

events.title: The Bubble Boy
events.description: George fights a 'bubble boy' over a Trivial Pursuit answer: 'The Moops'.

events.title: The Opera
events.description: Introduces 'Crazy' Joe Davola, who stalks the group while dressed as a clown from Pagliacci.

events.title: The Contest
events.description: The group bets on who can go the longest without 'self-gratification'. 'Master of my domain!'

events.title: The Visa
events.description: Babu Bhatt is deported after his visa renewal paperwork is delivered to Jerry's apartment by mistake.

events.title: The Outing
events.description: A journalist thinks Jerry and George are a couple. 'Not that there's anything wrong with that!'

events.title: The Implant
events.description: Jerry dates a woman he suspects has breast implants. 'They're real, and they're spectacular!'

events.title: The Junior Mint
events.description: Kramer and Jerry witness a surgery. Kramer drops a Junior Mint into the patient.

events.title: The Pilot
events.description: The fictional pilot 'Jerry' airs on NBC but is not picked up for a series.

events.title: The Mango
events.description: Season 5 premieres. Elaine admits she faked 'it' with Jerry during their relationship.

events.title: The Puffy Shirt
events.description: Jerry accidentally agrees to wear a 'pirate' shirt on The Today Show.

events.title: The Non-Fat Yogurt
events.description: The group suspects a 'non-fat' yogurt shop is lying. Rudy Giuliani makes a cameo.

events.title: The Conversion
events.description: George converts to Latvian Orthodox for a woman. Kramer discovers his 'Kavorka'.

events.title: The Stall
events.description: Elaine's bathroom neighbor won't 'spare a square'. Dan Cortese guest stars.

events.title: The Dinner Party
events.description: The group tries to buy a chocolate babka. 'Look to the cookie, Elaine!'

events.title: The Marine Biologist
events.description: George saves a whale with a Titleist golf ball. One of the show's most famous monologues.

events.title: The Raincoats
events.description: Jerry is caught making out during 'Schindler's List'. Kramer and Morty go into business.

events.title: The Hamptons
events.description: The group visits the Hamptons. George suffers from 'shrinkage' in the pool.

events.title: The Opposite
events.description: George decides to do the opposite of every instinct and finds success with the Yankees.

events.title: The Chaperone
events.description: Season 6 premieres. George changes the Yankees' uniforms to 100% cotton.

events.title: The Big Salad
events.description: George wants credit for buying Elaine a 'big salad'. Jerry dates a woman Newman dumped.

events.title: The Mom & Pop Store
events.description: George buys a car he thinks belonged to Jon Voight. Kramer helps a 'Mom & Pop' store.

events.title: The Race
events.description: Jerry races an old high school rival. Elaine is blacklisted by a delivery guy.

events.title: The Switch
events.description: Kramer's first name is revealed to be 'Cosmo'. Jerry tries to date his girlfriend's roommate.

events.title: The Label Maker
events.description: Introduces 're-gifting'. Kramer and Newman play a high-stakes game of Risk.

events.title: The Highlights of 100
events.description: A two-part retrospective celebrating the show's 100th episode milestone.

events.title: The Doorman
events.description: Frank Costanza and Kramer invent 'The Manssiere' (or 'The Bro').

events.title: The Fusilli Jerry
events.description: Kramer gets 'ASSMAN' license plates. Frank Costanza sits on a pasta statue of Jerry.

events.title: The Face Painter
events.description: Elaine's boyfriend Puddy paints his face for a hockey game. 'Gotta support the team!'

events.title: The Engagement
events.description: Season 7 premieres. George gets engaged to Susan Ross.

events.title: The Maestro
events.description: Elaine dates a conductor who insists on being called 'The Maestro'.

events.title: The Soup Nazi
events.description: The group visits a strict soup stand owner. 'No soup for you!'

events.title: The Sponge
events.description: Elaine's favorite contraceptive is discontinued. She evaluates men for 'spongeworthiness'.

events.title: The Rye
events.description: The Costanzas steal back a marble rye. Jerry steals one from an old lady.

events.title: The Cadillac
events.description: Jerry buys his dad a Cadillac. George tries to date Marisa Tomei.

events.title: The Calzone
events.description: George becomes Steinbrenner's favorite by bringing him calzones.

events.title: The Bottle Deposit
events.description: Kramer and Newman take a mail truck to Michigan to recycle bottles for 10 cents.

events.title: The Invitations
events.description: Season 7 finale. Susan Ross dies from licking toxic wedding envelopes.

events.title: The Foundation
events.description: Season 8 premieres. Larry David leaves the show as head writer.

events.title: The Bizarro Jerry
events.description: Elaine finds a group of friends who are the exact opposites of Jerry, George, and Kramer.

events.title: The Little Kicks
events.description: Elaine's terrible dancing is revealed. 'It's like a full-body dry heave set to music.'

events.title: The Chicken Roaster
events.description: A neon sign from Kenny Rogers Roasters drives Kramer crazy. He and Jerry swap apartments.

events.title: The Abstinence
events.description: George becomes a genius when he stops having sex. Elaine becomes stupid.

events.title: The Little Jerry
events.description: Kramer buys a rooster for cockfighting. Jerry's check bounces at a bodega.

events.title: The Pothole
events.description: Jerry drops a toothbrush in the toilet. Kramer adopts a mile of highway.

events.title: The Yada Yada
events.description: George's girlfriend 'yada yadas' over the best parts. Jerry thinks his dentist converted for the jokes.

events.title: The Muffin Tops
events.description: Elaine starts a business selling only the tops of muffins. 'Top of the Muffin to You!'

events.title: The Summer of George
events.description: Season 8 finale. George plans a summer of leisure but ends up in the hospital.

events.title: The Butter Shave
events.description: Season 9 premieres. Kramer shaves with butter and cooks himself in the sun.

events.title: The Serenity Now
events.description: Frank Costanza uses 'Serenity Now!' to control his temper. Kramer builds a porch.

events.title: The Merv Griffin Show
events.description: Kramer sets up the old Merv Griffin Show set in his apartment.

events.title: The Betrayal
events.description: The 'backwards' episode. The group goes to India for a wedding.

events.title: The Strike
events.description: The introduction of Festivus ('for the rest of us'). Kramer returns to H&H Bagels.

events.title: The Frogger
events.description: George tries to move a Frogger machine across a busy street without losing his high score.

events.title: The Puerto Rican Day
events.description: The second-to-last episode. The group is stuck in traffic during a parade.

events.title: The Finale
events.description: The series finale. The group is sentenced to one year in prison for violating a Good Samaritan law.

events.title: Seinfeld: Season 1 & 2 DVD Release
events.description: The first official DVD release of the series, sparking a new generation of fans.

events.title: Seinfeld Reunion on Curb Your Enthusiasm
events.description: The cast reunites for a fictional 7th season of Seinfeld during Curb's 7th season.

events.title: Comedians in Cars: Seinfeld Reunion
events.description: Jerry and Jason Alexander (as George) film a special Super Bowl spot at Tom's Restaurant.

events.title: Seinfeld Debuts on Netflix
events.description: The entire series becomes available on Netflix in 4K for the first time.
